title: 08 No 3V3 track into the output cells: NTC pull-ups at the MCU (05) and each switch's 10R VDD resistor on the 3V3 plane
why: The thin 3V3 track on B.Cu feeds four parts, not two: R607 and R707 (NTC pull-ups) and R601 and R701 (each switch's 10R VDD resistor). Moving the pull-ups alone leaves the whole track in place for the 10R resistors. Here the 10R resistors go onto the plane as well: R601 at the west margin's via, R801 at the east margin's via, R701 beside the NTC parts at the MCU. What enters each cell is then SW_VDD, the filtered side of the 10R, which already had to run round the switch to R6x4.
